decisions.direction: Run existing syntax compilation and project-catalog checks in an author-only browser Worker; preserve explicit preview/apply flow and one undoable application.
decisions.why: Separate long synchronous author work from the UI event loop without changing runtime interpretation.

decisions.direction: Bind tasks to request identity, source and current project/catalog context. Superseding compile, cancellation, reset and dispose invalidate the old task; terminate CPU-bound workers and reject late responses.
decisions.why: Cancellation messages alone cannot preempt synchronous code occupying a worker event loop; terminating the worker and checking identity address different failure modes.

decisions.direction: Keep compileTextScript/checkTextScriptProject synchronous pure APIs, DSL grammar, IR, source map and existing budgets; keep CLI/Agent contracts and runtime/save/replay behavior compatible.
decisions.why: The first deliverable is author-host scheduling and lifecycle, not a new compiler or VM.

decisions.direction: Do not add include syntax, file IO, namespace rules or multi-file project format in v1.4.0.
requiredBeforeLaterAdoption: Versioned named-source input contract and deterministic order
Cross-file duplicate IDs, forward references and include-cycle rules
Per-file UTF-16 source ranges and source identity
Independent CLI/Agent/Studio, package and save/replay validation
decisions.why: Per-file budget repetition can multiply total resource use; file origin and resolution require independent design.

decisions.direction: Do not add Electron IPC, an external inklecate process, temporary upstream project files, arbitrary filesystem loading, upstream runtime dependencies or copied compiler implementation.
decisions.why: Use concepts with an original browser-worker implementation inside the self-developed engine.

performanceScope.target: Studio main-thread responsiveness and bounded task lifecycle
performanceScope.prior7000CueWarning: The v1.3.0 optimized 7000-cue total author workload warning is separate historical evidence; moving work to a Worker does not prove lower total latency.
requiredMeasurement: Measure real UI event-loop responsiveness and cancellation
Record transfer/clone/render overhead separately where measured
